description: This file defines the NetworkExceptionInterface, an interface in the PSR HTTP Client standard that represents network-related exceptions thrown during HTTP request processing, extending the ClientExceptionInterface and including a method to retrieve the associated request.

classes.name: NetworkExceptionInterface
classes.description: An interface for network-related exceptions in HTTP client operations, extending ClientExceptionInterface and providing a method to access the associated HTTP request.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request associated with the exception, potentially a different object than originally sent.
